//: Module (sheet column 1) -> the captured route that IS that screen. DATA, not code: this moved out of scripts/triage-sheet.ts so no application name lives in a script. A wrong pairing manufactures a false ceiling in whichever direction it errs, so triage PRINTS this on every run and a human checks it by eye. Add a route when a module is captured; `skipped` records a module deliberately left unpaired and `notCaptured` one nobody has walked, because a blank, a decision and an absence are three different answers.

removed.user role: A TYPO of 'User Role', decided 2026-10-03. The two sheet cells are being corrected by hand; until then those rows are refused BY NAME, which is the visible version of the problem rather than a silent fix.
removed.Permissions: REMOVED 2026-10-03: no URL of its own in any capture.
